answer.sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT inv_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM inv_dt)::int AS yr
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv
  WHERE inv_dt >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01'
),
lns AS (
  SELECT inv_id, SUM(ext_prc - tax_amn) AS rev
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv_lns
  GROUP BY inv_id
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT i.yr, SUM(l.rev) AS revenue
  FROM inv i
  JOIN lns l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id
  GROUP BY i.yr
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2015 THEN revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN revenue END))
  / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN revenue END), 0) * 100, 1
) AS growth_pct
FROM yearly
LIMIT 501
